chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 206: Li Huowang's Brutal Awakening
chapter_meta_description: A psychiatrist's cruel provocation forces Li Huowang into a violent outburst, leading to a devastating realization about his own power and the danger he poses to those he loves most.
og_title: The Blow that Shattered His Sanity
og_description: Li Huowang is goaded into a fight by his new doctor, but the real damage is done when he returns to the Dao-Twisted World to find the face he bruised.
twitter_description: Chapter 206: Li Huowang learns the terrifying weight of his new power—and the cost is a bruise on the face of the one person who refuses to fear him.
